solution.title: Implement Entra ID Integration with ABM for Account Auto Provisioning for Microsoft Intune

products.name: Implement Entra ID Integration with ABM for Account Auto Provisioning for Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Integrate Microsoft Entra ID with Apple Business Manager — federated authentication + automatic Managed Apple ID provisioning (SCIM) — then enroll iPhones the right way for Corporate-Owned, BYOD, and Shared scenarios in Microsoft Intune. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Federate Entra ID with Apple Business Manager so Managed Apple IDs provision themselves — and every iPhone enrolls the right way

Managed Apple IDs are the backbone of modern iPhone management, but creating and maintaining them by hand — and reconciling them with your real users — is a slog, and it blocks the cleanest enrollment experiences. The fix is to integrate Microsoft Entra ID with Apple Business Manager: federate authentication so users sign in to Apple services with their Entra credentials, and auto-provision Managed Apple IDs from Entra (SCIM) so accounts simply exist when you need them. With that foundation in place, all three iPhone models — Corporate-Owned, BYOD, and Shared — enroll into Microsoft Intune the right way. This solution sets up the federation and auto-provisioning, then wires each enrollment scenario on top.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Entra ID ↔ Apple Business Manager federation works, automatic Managed Apple ID provisioning (SCIM from Entra plus just-in-time on first federated sign-in), how this enables the three iOS enrollment models, and the domain-capture / existing-Apple-ID conflict considerations.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID with the rights to federate + provision, Apple Business Manager, verified domain(s), the Apple MDM Push (APNs) certificate, the ADE enrollment token, Intune, user/group scoping, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: federate ABM with Entra ID, configure SCIM auto-provisioning of Managed Apple IDs (scoped to a pilot group first), resolve any existing-Apple-ID conflicts, then stand up enrollment for each model — Corporate-Owned (account-driven / ADE device enrollment), BYOD (account-driven user enrollment), and Shared (no-user-affinity with Managed Apple IDs) — then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • Per-scenario guidance — how the federated identity + Managed Apple ID flows into each model (COD vs BYOD vs Shared), what the end-user sign-in experience looks like, and how to keep them cleanly separated by group.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — federation/provisioning readiness discovery, per-user Managed-Apple-ID + per-device enrollment-model validation, a fleet provisioning-coverage and scenario-breakdown report, safe remediation (re-provision / fix scope), and a provisioning + enrollment scope-group builder for the three scenarios.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Entra ID federated with Apple Business Manager and Managed Apple IDs provisioning themselves — so Corporate-Owned, BYOD, and Shared iPhones all enroll into Intune cleanly on one identity — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ABMPROV-Discovery.ps1 — Entra ID + ABM federation / provisioning / ADE / APNs readiness (read-only)
    • ABMPROV-Remediation.ps1 — safely re-provision a user / fix scope-group membership (default -WhatIf)
    • ABMPROV-Report.ps1 — fleet Managed Apple ID provisioning coverage + COD/BYOD/Shared breakdown (read-only)
    • ABMPROV-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the provisioning + per-scenario enrollment scope groups (default -WhatIf)
    • ABMPROV-Validation.ps1 — per-user Managed Apple ID / federation + per-device enrollment-model check (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
